reviews.name: Laurie Streeter
reviews.text: Skip and his team did an excellent job regrading my entire yard and fixing my water problems in my back and front yard. We had a lake in my back and front anytime it would rain. They tied my gutters into drains to the ditch in front.

reviews.name: Brian Fleming
reviews.text: Small town landscaping and irrigation are by far one of the best companies I've ever worked with. They showed up when they said they was gonna show up. They walked me through the whole process. It's one of the first times in a long time that I feel like I got what I paid for. They will definitely be my go to company.

reviews.name: Donna Collins
reviews.text: Skip and his crew are very good. He laid sod in my yard and helped me extend my carport to make a small patio. Their work is very good, and their professionalism is excellent. We will be using him again in the future.
